short_description: Standalone evolutionary ecosystem research: grow ecology from landscape/history without player or biome species tables, then later transfer and continue the same ecology inside the world simulator.
purpose: Build a reusable autonomous evolutionary ecology mini-project that evolves plant and later multi-trophic ecosystems from causal environment/resource/competition/history rules, exports portable spatial ecology state, and eventually feeds World Generation/local/background simulation without duplicate ecology truth.
current_stage: ECO.EVO0 / CAL1-B Implemented Candidate / Exact Windows Causal Gate
progress_note: CAL1-A is accepted on exact Windows evidence with baseline_hash=280980c13b2545e66af94d10cc35f707c506365c65df9efeddb07b037588cb0f and PH3C hash=294ebcd81db924421a916ad599711146c4047f0e295fe76f715fff11e548b7fb. CAL1-B implementation now exists at 561daee4cd9fa48bcef5c78e6f2b0d050451f3b9. It introduces a separate zero-sum relative vertical-light mechanism: contested light pool is bounded by accepted PH3 height_light_access_gain * sunlight * canopy_overlap * local_density; relative height redistributes that pool between pair members. No-neighbour and equal-height cases are neutral, dense tall-vs-short gives tall positive/short negative delta, sparse strongly reduces the effect, dry dense keeps existing structural/water economics, and A/B swap is tested for exact symmetry. Accepted PH3/PH3C sources and runtime paths are unmodified. Exact Windows canonical evidence is required before CAL1-B acceptance or CAL1-C execution.
next_stage: Run RUN_ECO_CAL1_B_TESTS.ps1 on exact Windows checkout. Record aggregate hash, dense/sparse deltas and ratio, reference/dry score gaps before/after, fresh-process equality and CAL1-A/PH3C parent preservation. If accepted, start CAL1-C crown/root competition. No coefficient calibration before CAL1-E.
